articles.title: What My data is, and how the tools use it
articles.summary: My data is the one shared data home of all Nivesh Sahayak tools: its sections, the Get set up checklist, and why details typed once appear everywhere.

articles.title: Add your business (and more than one)
articles.summary: Add or edit your business in My data: GSTIN and GST registration, address, bank and UPI for the QR code, logo, signature, type of business and partners.

articles.title: Customers and suppliers
articles.summary: Add customers and suppliers once in My data: GSTIN and state, ship-to address, group, price type, credit limit and credit days used by dues and reminders.

articles.title: Items and services
articles.summary: Add items and services in My data: HSN/SAC, unit, retail and wholesale rate, MRP, purchase price, GST, batch, expiry or serial tracking and a second unit.

articles.title: Groups of customers, suppliers and items
articles.summary: Make groups and sub-groups of customers, suppliers and items in My data: rename, merge, delete, and how groups reach reports, stock and Tally.

articles.title: Every saved document in one list
articles.summary: See every document saved by any Nivesh Sahayak tool in My data: search, open it in its maker, see its changes, export CSV or registers in Excel.

articles.title: Number series of each document
articles.summary: Set the invoice number series and every other document's prefix in My data or from each maker, with financial-year restart and the GST 16-character rule.

articles.title: Settings for every tool
articles.summary: All My data settings: default business, backup reminder, new invoice defaults, PIN lock, godowns, salesmen, custom fields, stock valuation and final accounts format.

articles.title: Back up and restore your data
articles.summary: Save one backup file of everything in Nivesh Sahayak, keep it safe, restore it on any computer or phone, and use a locked (password) backup.

articles.title: One auto save for all tools (computer only)
articles.summary: Choose a folder once on my.niveshsahayak.in and every save in any Nivesh Sahayak tool updates one backup file there. Computer only, Chrome or Edge.

articles.title: Move your data to a new computer or phone
articles.card: Move to a new computer or phone
articles.summary: Take all your bills, customers and accounts to another computer or phone: save a backup, copy it, restore on the new device, and switch on auto save there.

articles.title: Import items, parties and opening balances from Excel
articles.summary: Bring items, customers and suppliers, and opening balances into Nivesh Sahayak from one Excel file: download the blank file, fill it, check every row, import.

articles.title: Recycle bin and edit history
articles.summary: Get back a deleted bill or party from the Nivesh Sahayak recycle bin, and see every change in the edit history: when, what and the old value.

articles.title: Send your accountant one file
articles.summary: Make one file for your accountant from My data: registers in Excel, Tally files and your documents for a month, quarter or year, ready to send.
